prior.value: has just met Maya for the first time; does not know about the contract
prior.quote: So THIS is the mystery girl!

new.value: believes Vanessa has never met Maya (claimed by Adrian); Vanessa's plot is unknown to him
new.quote: Vanessa, you've never even met Maya. Stay away from her.

issues.explanation: Adrian claims Vanessa has never met Maya, but Vanessa already met and confronted Maya in Ep3 (and in Ep1 at the diner), and Adrian was present or aware of it.
issues.suggested_fix: Change Adrian's line to 'Stay away from Maya' or 'Leave Maya alone'.

prior.value: needs eighty thousand dollars (for his care)
prior.quote: I know. Eighty thousand dollars. I'll find it. I promise.

new.value: is covering a $120,000 cost for Sam
new.quote: A hundred and twenty thousand dollars, Sam. It's covered. You just focus on getting stronger.

issues.explanation: Sam's care was established as costing eighty thousand dollars (repeated in Ep2 and Ep5), but Maya now says it is a hundred and twenty thousand with no explanation of the increase.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the line to 'Eighty thousand dollars, Sam' or add a line explaining that complications raised the cost to $120,000.

prior.quote: MAYA COLLINS (24), apron stained, balances four plates.

new.quote: I'm only twenty-two, Adrian. I stopped believing in fairy tales a long time ago.

issues.explanation: Maya was established as 24 years old in Episode 1 but now says she is only twenty-two, with no on-screen explanation.
issues.suggested_fix: Change Maya's line to 'I'm only twenty-four, Adrian.'

prior.value: died in a crash five years ago
prior.quote: My father built Cross Capital from nothing before the crash took him five years ago.

new.value: will ask his father for help with Derek tonight
new.quote: I'll ask my father tonight. He'll know exactly how to handle Derek.

issues.explanation: Adrian's father died in a crash five years ago, yet Adrian says he will ask his father for help tonight.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the line to ask someone else, e.g. 'I'll ask my father's old lawyer tonight.'

prior.value: had surgery that was a complete success
prior.quote: Maya, Sam's surgery was a complete success.

new.value: is awaiting surgery, date keeps being pushed
new.quote: Sam is still waiting for his surgery. The doctors keep pushing the date.

issues.explanation: Ep7 established Sam's surgery was a complete success, but Ep9 says Sam is still waiting for surgery with the date being pushed.
issues.suggested_fix: Change Maya's line to say Sam is still recovering and the doctors are keeping him for follow-up checks.

prior.quote: My daughter Mia vanished twenty years ago, Martin.

new.value: claims Maya is his daughter, Emma Hale
new.quote: This is my daughter, Emma Hale. And today she comes home.

issues.explanation: Richard's missing daughter was named Mia, but he now claims his daughter is Emma Hale.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the name to Mia in the announcement line.

prior.value: learns Vanessa has been blackmailing Maya
prior.quote: Adrian's jaw tightens. He reads every message.

new.value: learns Vanessa blackmailed Maya; Maya never told him
new.quote: Vanessa blackmailed you? Why didn't you ever tell me?

issues.explanation: Adrian already learned of Vanessa's blackmail in Ep7 (read the messages, fired her), so he cannot now be learning of it and asking why Maya never told him.
issues.suggested_fix: Change Adrian's line to something like 'Why did you keep carrying it alone?' or remove the surprise.

prior.value: birth name is Mia Hale (claimed by Richard)
prior.quote: Your name is Mia Hale. I put that locket on you myself.

new.value: publicly introduced as Richard's daughter Emma Hale
new.quote: This is my daughter, Emma Hale. And today she comes home.

issues.explanation: Richard established Maya's birth name as Mia Hale (his daughter Mia vanished 20 years ago), but he now introduces her as Emma Hale.
issues.suggested_fix: Change 'Emma Hale' to 'Mia Hale' in Richard's announcement.

prior.value: lives in a one-room apartment on Maple Street
prior.quote: I go home every night to a one-room apartment on Maple Street.

new.value: lives in an apartment building on Oak Avenue
new.quote: I drove past this building on Oak Avenue three times before I found the courage to knock.

issues.explanation: Maya was established as living in a one-room apartment on Maple Street, but in Ep8 her apartment building is on Oak Avenue, with no move shown.
issues.suggested_fix: Change 'Oak Avenue' to 'Maple Street' in the Ep8 dialogue and slugline.

prior.value: was four years old when found by Grace
prior.quote: I was four. I don't remember anything before that.

new.value: was lost at a carnival at age two
new.quote: You were only two years old when I lost you at that carnival.

issues.explanation: Maya said she was four when Grace found her alone at the carnival, but Richard says she was two when he lost her at the carnival. Both could be true only if two years passed between, which is unexplained.
issues.suggested_fix: Change Richard's line to 'You were only four years old when I lost you at that carnival.'

prior.value: had not opened the locket in years
prior.quote: She opens the locket for the first time in years.

new.value: has carried her father's photograph for twenty years
new.quote: A con artist doesn't carry her father's photograph for twenty years without knowing it.

issues.explanation: Maya had not opened the locket in years and learned of her father only in Ep8, and was found at age four, so she cannot have carried her father's photo for twenty years knowingly; also the photo was only newly seen.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the line to 'carry her father's photograph around her neck for twenty years without knowing it' or similar.

prior.value: was engaged to Adrian for two years (claimed by Vanessa)
prior.quote: I was engaged to him for two years.

new.value: claims she gave Adrian four years of her life (past relationship)
new.quote: I gave that man four years of my life. I'm not losing him to a waitress.

issues.explanation: Vanessa said in Ep3 she was engaged to Adrian for two years, but in Ep5 she says she gave him four years of her life; the durations differ.
issues.suggested_fix: Change Vanessa's Ep5 line to 'two years of my life', or establish that they dated two years before the two-year engagement.

new.quote: Miss Collins was seen with Adrian Cross's cousin Chloe at St. Luke's Hospital yesterday.

issues.explanation: Chloe was established as Adrian's little sister (and she calls him her brother in Ep6), but Martin calls her Adrian's cousin.
issues.suggested_fix: Change Martin's line to 'Adrian Cross's sister Chloe', or have Richard correct Martin's mistaken information.

prior.quote: I'm the marketing director here, sweetheart

new.value: was head of legal at Cross Capital
new.quote: When I was head of legal at Cross Capital, I read every contract he signed.

issues.explanation: Vanessa was established as the marketing director at Cross Tower, not head of legal at Cross Capital.
